fusions.name: First Report
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a target that has not been hurt yet, its critical chance is 50% higher.

fusions.name: Scattershot Snap
fusions.desc: Blasts a short cone of shot ahead of you that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 32%).

fusions.name: Cocked and Waiting
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds and restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Hangfire
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
